messages:
jamal: Heads up — Sales flagged two enterprise deals asking for an 'unlimited embeddings' add-on and custom per-call rates. Can we decide whether to add an embeddings unlimited tier or enforce caps? Also need launch criteria for public pricing doc by EOW.

maria: Quick context — both deals are mid-7 figures ARR but expect heavy vector storage + embedding QPS. Options: A) paid 'embeddings+storage' addon with soft cap (100M units/mo), B) enterprise-only 'unlimited' w/ 12mo commit & premium, C) per-embedding overage. Need perf + ops cost numbers to pick.

elaine: From infra: unlimited is risky. Storage + ANN ops scale linearly. We can do soft caps + throttles and tiered discounts. Need telemetry to compute unit-cost per 1M embeddings. Also require kill switch.

josh: Sales feedback: they prefer option B for close velocity — customers ask for 'unlimited' explicitly. Suggest enterprise-only unlimited behind commit + higher SLA. Can we price protective guardrails? :money_with_wings:

ravi: Legal note: avoid absolute 'unlimited' in public docs. Define as 'unmetered up to agreed committed baseline; any usage materially above baseline subject to negotiation/overage or migration cadence.' Also need explicit data retention & egress terms for stored vectors.

maria: Proposed launch criteria: 1) pricing language reviewed by Legal, 2) cost model validated and shown in PRD, 3) telemetry & metering in place, 4) ops runbook + throttle/kill-switch, 5) sales playbook + concession matrix. If we hit these we can publish.

elaine: Implementation notes: we can reuse existing cache + throttle code but need an ANN storage quota enforcement path. ETA ~3 sprints for basic gating + telemetry, 5 sprints for smoother unthrottled experience. Need product prioritization to start.

josh: @maria If we gate unlimited behind 12mo commit, sales can offer a one-time migration credit to close. That helps.

maria: Decision proposal: go with B for enterprise deals (12mo commit + custom SLA + legal T&Cs) + ship a public 'embeddings addon' with soft-cap tiers for self-serve (A/C). Action: if no objections by EOD Friday I'll start a PRD and scope.

product-bot: jira: Created RD-9876 'Embeddings addon: enterprise unlimited + public tiers' (assignee: maria). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RD-9876

ravi: Agree pending contract language review. I'll draft suggested clause for 'unlimited' and data terms by Wed.

maria: Quick config sketch for billing team:
```
billing:
  embeddings:
    tiers:
      - name: self-serve-basic
        cap: 10M
      - name: self-serve-pro
        cap: 100M
      - name: enterprise-unlimited
        commit: 12mo
        sla: custom
```

maria: Thanks all — I'll capture comments in the PRD. Ping me on Slack if you're blocked.
